content: रसिक {%a.%} [रसोऽस्त्यस्य ठन्] .²1 Savoury, sapid, tasteful. .²2 Graceful, elegant, beautiful. .²3 Impassioned. .²4 Apprehending flavour or excellence, possessed of taste, appreciative, discriminating; तद् वृत्तं प्रवदन्ति काव्यरसिकाः शार्दूलविक्रीडितम् <ls>Śrut. 40</ls>. .²5 Finding pleasure or taking delight in, delighting in, devoted to (usually in <ab>comp.</ab>); इयं मालती भगवता सदृशसंयोगरसिकेन वेधसा मन्मथेन मया च तुभ्यं दीयते <ls>Māl. 6</ls>; so कामरसिकः <ls>Bh. 3. 112</ls>; परोपकाररसिकस्य <ls>Mk. 6. 19</ls>. .²6 Humorous, witty. .²7 Fanciful. .²8 Lustful. .{@-कः@} .²1 A man of taste or feeling, an appreciator of excellence or beauty; <ab>cf.</ab> अरसिक. .²2 A libertine. .²3 An elephant. .²4 A horse. .²5 The Sārasa bird. .{@-का@} .²1 The juice of sugar-cane, molasses. .²2 The tongue. .²3 A womanʼs girdle; see रसाला also.
